favourite.heading: Why Auburn can pull away

underdog.heading: Why Southern Miss can keep it close
bullets: The outcome range is 15.5 points wide at one sigma — p10 +1.4 to p90 +46.4 for Auburn, so a projection of +25.4 still produces results a long way either side of it.
It is early enough that both ratings still lean on preseason belief — it widens the outcome range by about 6%.
